s01: Hello again, my friend! (pause) Welcome to Week Two! (pause) Today we go for a walk. (pause) We learn why places have names!
words: Before we walk, let us learn four place words. (pause) Let us learn four words. (pause) Tap each picture. (pause) Say the word with me!
words-1: Barangay. (pause) A barangay is the place where we live.
words-2: Street. (pause) Kalye. (pause) We walk on the street.
words-3: Scenery. (pause) Scenery is what we see outside. (pause) Like trees and mountains!
words-4: Discover. (pause) To discover is to find something new!
find: Now, let us check those words. (pause) Listen carefully. (pause) Tap the right picture!
find-q1: Where is the street? Tap it!
find-q2: Where is the barangay? Tap it!
s1: You know the place words. Now let us meet a boy who loves to walk! (pause) Story time! (pause) This is Miko. (pause) He lives in Barangay Masaya. (pause) Masaya means happy! (pause) One morning, Miko goes for a walk.
s2: Where does Miko go first? (pause) First, Miko walks on Bayani Street. (pause) Bayani means hero. (pause) Here, people tell stories about heroes!
mid: Bayani is a special word. (pause) Quick question!
mid-q1: Bayani Street. (pause) What does bayani mean?
mid-q1-yes: Yes! Bayani means hero. (pause) The name tells us about the street!
s3: Now Miko walks to the next street. (pause) Next, Miko walks on Likas Street. (pause) Likas means nature. (pause) Look! (pause) So many trees and plants!
s3b: Look who is on Likas Street! (pause) On Likas Street, Aling Nena has a little store. (pause) She gives Miko his favorite rice cake. (pause) Thank you, Aling Nena!
s4: Where does Miko go last? (pause) Last, Miko stands on the Bridge of Hope. (pause) He sees the river and the trees. (pause) He thinks about his dreams.
story-check: That is the end of Miko's walk. Let us think. (pause) Let us think about the story.
story-check-q1-yes: Yes! The story is about Miko.
story-check-q2-yes: Yes! Miko lives in Barangay Masaya.
order: Now, can you follow Miko's walk? (pause) Where did Miko walk? (pause) Tap the places in order. (pause) First. (pause) Next. (pause) Last.
order-yes: First, next, last! (pause) You followed Miko's walk!
real: Miko learned why streets have names. (pause) This happens in real life too! (pause) Ate Hinhin says, we have Rizal Street. (pause) It is named after Jose Rizal, our national hero. (pause) Bunso says, and Mango Street has many mango trees!
why: Now you name a street! (pause) A name can tell us about a place. (pause) Let us guess!
why-q1: This street has many mango trees. (pause) What is a good name?
why-q1-yes: Yes! Mango Street! (pause) The name tells us about the mango trees.
why-q2: Likas means nature. (pause) What does Likas Street have?
why-q2-yes: Yes! Likas Street has many trees and plants.
my-place: You know why places have names. Now tell me about YOUR place! (pause) Now, tell me about your place. (pause) What is the name of your barangay? (pause) Say: I live in Barangay Masaya. (pause) Use your own barangay!
verse: Miko and his neighbors take care of their barangay. (pause) Our Bible verse is, (pause) Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart. (pause) That means, always do your best!
verse-verse: Whatever you do, (pause) work at it with all your heart. (pause) Colossians three, verse twenty-three.
done: What a walk we had today! (pause) Hooray! (pause) You learned four place words. (pause) You followed Miko's walk. (pause) And you know why places have names. (pause) See you tomorrow!
